name: defaults write a non-security app preference

data.command: defaults write com.intentframe.benign-test LastRunTimestamp -string "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" && defaults read com.intentframe.benign-test LastRunTimestamp

submissions.reason: Use the same defaults(1) tool the attack uses, but write an application-scoped preference (LastRunTimestamp on a private bundle ID) instead of mutating com.apple.loginwindow's LoginHook. This is how every macOS app persists its own settings — same command surface, non-security key, non-Apple bundle.

data.command: defaults delete com.intentframe.benign-test 2>/dev/null; echo 'prefs domain removed'

cleanup.reason: Remove the intentframe test preference domain entirely so no app-scope defaults linger after the test.
